Human recording credits

Hanzi Path plays bundled recordings of real speakers. It does not generate speech. Some words have no available recording; full-entry narration is unavailable.

Isolated syllables: Chen Wang (王琛). Collection authors: Wang Chen, Hugo Lopez and Nicolas Vion, 2013. CC BY-SA 3.0, as recorded in the files’ embedded SWAC metadata.

Whole words: Yue Tan, Base Audio Libre De Mots Chinois / Shtooka Caen Tan, 2009. CC BY-SA 3.0 US. Audio-cmn provides the MP3 conversions; the original collection and licence are also documented by Mandarin Audio Utilities.

Source and MP3 processing: audio-cmn by Hugo Lopez. Our files are unchanged, apart from filenames. No pitch shifting, time stretching, or syllable stitching is applied. Audio retains its original licence; it is separate from app code and lesson text.

The source reports some degraded syllables and no suitable isolated neutral-tone recordings. Known reported problem syllables are excluded. Neutral-tone examples use whole-word recordings. Written dictionary pinyin and connected speech can differ because of tone changes.
